title: Wonderful tour of Barcelona and Gaudi's architecture!
text: This was our second time touring with We Are Guides Barcelona.  We were arriving early and got in touch with Josep from We Are Guides.  We wanted to have an airport transfer plus a 4 hour tour before our hotel check in.  Josep arranged a driver to pick us up at the airport and then we met our wonderful guide, Diana, in Barcelona.  Our first stop was Casa Vicens.  Diana gave us so much information about Gaudi and Casa Vicens.  It was all so interesting.  She is very knowledgeable.
